description: Compute month-over-month (MoM) growth of active subscribers per plan from monthly snapshots. For each snapshot row, prev_month_subscribers is the value for the same plan in the immediately preceding CALENDAR month; if there is no snapshot for that calendar month, prev_month_subscribers and mom_pct are NULL. mom_pct = 100 * (current - previous) / previous. Output columns: plan_name (STRING), snapshot_month (DATE), active_subscribers (INT64), prev_month_subscribers (INT64), mom_pct (FLOAT64, 1 decimal). Sort by plan_name, snapshot_month.

snapshot_month.description: First day of the month; months can be missing when the snapshot job failed

edge_cases: March snapshot is missing, so April must not be compared with February
First month of each plan has NULL growth
Previous value of 0 must yield NULL mom_pct, not an error
Each plan is compared only with its own history
common_failure_modes: FM2: LAG() ordered by snapshot_month compares April with February (previous row), reporting 10% growth across a two-month gap
FM3: Missing PARTITION BY plan_id compares one plan against another
